load necessary libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
library(janitor)
```

# Problem 1
```{r}
subway_data = read_csv("data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv") |>     clean_names() |> 
  select(
    line, 
    station_name, 
    station_latitude, 
    station_longitude, 
    starts_with("route"), 
    entrance_type, 
    entry, 
    vending, 
    ada
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    entry = case_match(
      entry, 
      "YES" ~ TRUE, 
      "NO" ~ FALSE 
    ) 
  )
```
